evals.prompt: 根據過去一個月給的閱讀建議來分析哪一個電子報值得繼續訂閱，哪一個電子報可以考慮取消訂閱，並請說明原因
evals.expected_output: Runs subscription analyzer across past 30 days, generates a structured markdown audit artifact with telemetry table, categorizes newsletters into Keep, Unsubscribe, and Adjust with concrete data (acceptance rate, yield, veto reasons), and provides Gmail search queries for manual unsubscribing.

evals.prompt: Should I still subscribe to ByteByteGo and Hugging Face Daily Papers? Check my past 30 days feedback and suggest whether to keep or cancel.
evals.expected_output: Evaluates ByteByteGo and Hugging Face Daily Papers specifically using data from reports and suggestions_reviewed.md/suggestions_filtered.md, identifies low acceptance and hard-veto violations, and recommends Unsubscribe with exact rationale.

evals.prompt: 幫我審查最近的電子報訂閱狀況，列出噪音最多、最建議取消的電子報清單和過濾建議
evals.expected_output: Audits newsletter inbox volume and triage categories, highlights high-noise sources (e.g. Hugging Face, Gary Chen, ByteByteGo) and recommends exact Gmail filter rules for high-volume mixed sources (e.g. Superhuman Sunday Special).
